-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Pantry: one US business's books, statements, reconciliation and close.
-- Money is integer US cents. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Every mutable row carries a
-- revision that changes on every write; approvals name the revision they saw.

-- A failed CHECK aborts the whole D1 batch: write batches insert one row per
-- authority or state condition and delete them at the end.
CREATE TABLE pt_guard (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok = 1));

CREATE TABLE pt_entity (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
 legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL,
 currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK (currency = 'USD'),
 fiscal_year_start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (fiscal_year_start BETWEEN 1 AND 12),
 book_basis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'accrual' CHECK (book_basis = 'accrual'),
 tax_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tax_method IN ('cash', 'accrual', 'undeclared')),
 policies TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 books_start TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pt_members (
 email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('bookkeeper', 'accountant', 'viewer')),
 can_post INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_post IN (0, 1)),
 can_lock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_lock IN (0, 1)),
 can_reopen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_reopen IN (0, 1)),
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pt_agents (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pt_accounts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'income', 'expense')),
 subtype TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other' CHECK (subtype IN ('bank', 'receivable', 'payable', 'tax', 'retained', 'other')),
 description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- One receivable and one payable control account carry the subledgers.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pt_accounts_one_receivable ON pt_accounts(subtype) WHERE subtype IN ('receivable', 'payable', 'retained');

CREATE TABLE pt_contacts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('customer', 'vendor')),
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 terms_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30 CHECK (terms_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365),
 external_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

CREATE TABLE pt_tax_codes (

);

CREATE TABLE pt_journal_entries (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 number INTEGER UNIQUE,
 entry_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 memo TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('manual', 'opening', 'invoice', 'credit', 'bill', 'payment', 'bank', 'reversal')),
 source_id TEXT,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'posted')),
 prepared_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 prepared_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (prepared_kind IN ('person', 'agent', 'import')),
 proposal_id TEXT,
 document_id TEXT REFERENCES pt_documents(id),
 posted_by TEXT,
 posted_at TEXT,
 reverses_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES pt_journal_entries(id),
 reversed_by_id TEXT REFERENCES pt_journal_entries(id),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX pt_journal_entries_date ON pt_journal_entries(status, entry_date);

CREATE TABLE pt_journal_lines (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pt_journal_entries(id),
 line_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
 account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pt_accounts(id),
 debit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (debit_cents >= 0),
 credit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (credit_cents >= 0),
 memo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 contact_id TEXT REFERENCES pt_contacts(id),
 CHECK ((debit_cents = 0) <> (credit_cents = 0)),
 UNIQUE (entry_id, line_no)
);
CREATE INDEX pt_journal_lines_account ON pt_journal_lines(account_id);

CREATE TABLE pt_periods (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]'),
 start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'locked')),
 locked_by TEXT,
 locked_at TEXT,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Posted history is immutable: lines of a posted entry never change, a posted
-- entry is never deleted, and its only later change links its reversal.
CREATE TRIGGER pt_lines_posted_update BEFORE UPDATE ON pt_journal_lines
WHEN (SELECT status FROM pt_journal_entries WHERE id = OLD.entry_id) = 'posted'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POSTED_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER pt_lines_posted_delete BEFORE DELETE ON pt_journal_lines
WHEN (SELECT status FROM pt_journal_entries WHERE id = OLD.entry_id) = 'posted'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POSTED_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER pt_lines_posted_insert BEFORE INSERT ON pt_journal_lines
WHEN (SELECT status FROM pt_journal_entries WHERE id = NEW.entry_id) = 'posted'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POSTED_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER pt_entries_posted_delete BEFORE DELETE ON pt_journal_entries
WHEN OLD.status = 'posted'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POSTED_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER pt_entries_posted_update BEFORE UPDATE ON pt_journal_entries
WHEN OLD.status = 'posted' AND NOT (
 OLD.reversed_by_id IS NULL AND NEW.reversed_by_id IS NOT NULL
 AND NEW.id = OLD.id AND NEW.number IS OLD.number AND NEW.entry_date = OLD.entry_date AND NEW.memo = OLD.memo
 AND NEW.status = OLD.status AND NEW.source_kind = OLD.source_kind AND NEW.source_id IS OLD.source_id
 AND NEW.posted_by IS OLD.posted_by AND NEW.posted_at IS OLD.posted_at AND NEW.reverses_id IS OLD.reverses_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POSTED_IMMUTABLE'); END;
-- Posting checks balance and the period lock in the database itself.
CREATE TRIGGER pt_entries_post BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON pt_journal_entries
WHEN OLD.status = 'draft' AND NEW.status = 'posted'
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_UNBALANCED') WHERE
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pt_journal_lines WHERE entry_id = NEW.id) < 2
  OR (SELECT SUM(debit_cents) FROM pt_journal_lines WHERE entry_id = NEW.id) <> (SELECT SUM(credit_cents) FROM pt_journal_lines WHERE entry_id = NEW.id)
  OR (SELECT SUM(debit_cents) FROM pt_journal_lines WHERE entry_id = NEW.id) <= 0;
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_PERIOD_LOCKED') WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pt_periods WHERE status = 'locked' AND NEW.entry_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER pt_entries_insert_posted BEFORE INSERT ON pt_journal_entries
WHEN NEW.status = 'posted'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_POST_THROUGH_DRAFT'); END;
-- Drafts dated in a locked period cannot be created or changed either.
CREATE TRIGGER pt_entries_draft_locked BEFORE INSERT ON pt_journal_entries
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_periods WHERE status = 'locked' AND NEW.entry_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PANTRY_PERIOD_LOCKED'); END;

-- Reports a business files from: sales tax by state, 1099 contractors and the
-- way each payment was made (card and payment-network payments are reported by
-- the processor on 1099-K, so they stay out of 1099-NEC totals).

-- Each sales tax code belongs to a state. Codes made before this change were
-- the business's own home-state rates; they start in the business's state and
-- can be moved to another state on the tax code screen.
ALTER TABLE pt_tax_codes ADD COLUMN state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '';
UPDATE pt_tax_codes SET state = COALESCE((SELECT state FROM pt_entity WHERE id = 1), '');

-- How a recorded payment left or reached the bank. Older payments say "unrecorded"
-- until a person sets it.
ALTER TABLE pt_payments ADD COLUMN method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unrecorded'
 CHECK (method IN ('unrecorded', 'check', 'ach', 'wire', 'cash', 'card', 'payment-network'));

-- Vendors paid for services who get a 1099-NEC.
ALTER TABLE pt_contacts ADD COLUMN is_1099 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_1099 IN (0, 1));

-- The contractor's filing details. The TIN is a protected field: screens and
-- views only ever see its last four digits; the full number leaves only in the
-- filing CSV, for the owner or a person with the posting grant, and every such
-- download is in the audit trail.
CREATE TABLE pt_contractor_tax (
 contact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pt_contacts(id),
 legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 tin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tin_kind IN ('ssn', 'ein')),
 tin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(tin) = 9 AND tin NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
 address TEXT NOT NULL,
 city TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL,
 zip TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Bank rules and live bank and card feeds.
-- Statement lines now also arrive from a feed, so a line no longer needs a
-- statement; a feed line carries the provider's transaction id, and a file line
-- the feed recognised carries it too, so neither source duplicates the other.
PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = on;

-- Matched lines are set aside while pt_bank_lines is rebuilt and put back after:
-- D1 always enforces foreign keys, and dropping the old table with matches still
-- pointing at it fails the commit even though the same ids return under the new one.
CREATE TABLE pt_match_bank_lines_keep AS SELECT match_id, bank_line_id, active FROM pt_match_bank_lines;
DELETE FROM pt_match_bank_lines;

 description TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
 source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'file' CHECK (source IN ('file', 'feed')),
 payee TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 feed_txn_id TEXT,
 removed_at TEXT,
 rules_off INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rules_off IN (0, 1)),
 arrived_at TEXT,
 CHECK (statement_id IS NOT NULL OR source = 'feed'),

-- read by the install's own AI model, matched to a transaction, and attached
-- once a person accepts it (or a rule the business set says so).

-- document row then holds an empty content and the SHA-256 of the whole file.

 document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pt_documents(id),

 PRIMARY KEY (document_id, seq)
);

CREATE TABLE pt_receipts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

migrations.sql:
-- Dated prices preserve earlier approved amounts instead of editing history.
ALTER TABLE pt_recurring ADD COLUMN amount_snapshot TEXT CHECK (amount_snapshot IS NULL OR json_valid(amount_snapshot));

-- Tax-code rates are immutable. Reconstruct the original line amounts from
-- their saved quantities, rates and tax codes so existing approvals survive.
-- Leave an inconsistent legacy record without a snapshot: it needs review.
WITH units AS (
 SELECT r.id, j.key AS line_no,
  CAST(round(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.quantity') AS REAL) * 1000) AS INTEGER) AS qty,
  CAST(round(CAST(replace(replace(json_extract(j.value, '$.rate'), ',', ''), '$', '') AS REAL) * 100) AS INTEGER) AS unit,
  coalesce(t.rate_milli_percent, 0) AS tax_rate
 FROM pt_recurring r, json_each(r.lines) j
 LEFT JOIN pt_tax_codes t ON t.id = json_extract(j.value, '$.taxCode')
), amounts AS (
 SELECT id, line_no, CAST(round(qty * unit / 1000.0) AS INTEGER) AS amount, tax_rate FROM units
), taxed AS (
 SELECT id, line_no, amount, CAST(round(amount * tax_rate / 100000.0) AS INTEGER) AS tax FROM amounts
), snapshots AS (
 SELECT id, json_group_array(json_array(amount, tax)) AS snapshot, sum(amount) AS subtotal, sum(tax) AS tax
 FROM (SELECT * FROM taxed ORDER BY id, line_no) GROUP BY id
)
UPDATE pt_recurring SET amount_snapshot = (
 SELECT s.snapshot FROM snapshots s WHERE s.id = pt_recurring.id
 AND s.subtotal = pt_recurring.subtotal_cents AND s.tax = pt_recurring.tax_cents
 AND s.subtotal + s.tax = pt_recurring.total_cents
);

 > CASE WHEN NEW.source_kind='payment' THEN (SELECT amount_cents FROM pt_payments WHERE id=NEW.source_id AND direction='received' AND reversal_id IS NULL) ELSE (SELECT total_cents FROM pt_invoices WHERE id=NEW.source_id AND kind='credit' AND status='issued' AND early_reversal_id IS NULL) END

BEGIN

 + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM pt_allocations WHERE source_kind=NEW.source_kind AND source_id=NEW.source_id AND voided_by IS NULL)
